[APPENDIX] Rules on Health Examinations for Persons Engaged in Food Sanitation [Table] <Amended on April 28, 2022>

Health Examination Items (Related to Article 2 (1))

Persons Subject to Examination:
Persons directly engaged in the collection, manufacture, processing, cooking, storage, transport, or sale of food or food additives (excluding chemically synthesized products and sterilizers or disinfectants for utensils, etc.): Provided, That business operators or employees engaged in the transport or sale of completely packaged food or food additives shall be excluded.

Health Examination Items:
1. Typhoid fever (limited to persons engaged in food-sanitation-related businesses and institutional food service facilities);
2. Pulmonary tuberculosis;
3. Communicable skin diseases (meaning bacterial skin diseases, such as Hansen's disease).
